note: Seed/demo posts, written for this project - not scraped from real accounts. Used by ingestion.sources.MockSource so the app has something to show before real API credentials are configured.

reports.text: Baner Rd underpass flooded again after 20 min rain, bikes stalling every monsoon evening.
Traffic backed up till Aundh chowk because of the same pothole cluster near DP road.
Broken storm drain cover near the ITI junction, dangerous for two-wheelers.
Bin outside the Kothrud vegetable market hasn't been cleared in four days, smell is unbearable.
Stray dogs scattering waste across the Kothrud Depot signal every morning.
Entire stretch near Warje flyover has been dark for a week, feels unsafe walking back.
Low water pressure again in Karve Nagar lanes 3 and 4 since Monday.
JM Road to Ganesh Peth is bumper to bumper every evening, signal timing seems off.
Illegal parking blocking the market entrance lane near Appa Balwant Chowk.
Sewage line burst near Vishrantwadi bridge, water mixing with the storm drain since yesterday.
Hadapsar Gaothan junction under a foot of water within 15 minutes of rain.
Garbage collection truck skipped Satavwadi lane again this week.
Third week of thin water supply in NIBM Road society clusters, tankers being called privately.
Kharadi bypass to EON is a parking lot every evening 6-8pm.
Pothole belt on the service road near the IT park gate, three reviews this month.
